name: Nouf-ex — Technical Review Workflow (A to Z)

nodes.name: Weekly Trigger (Monday 09:00)
nodes.notes: Runs every Monday at 09:00. Can also be triggered manually via Execute Workflow button.

nodes.name: Set Workflow Variables
nodes.notes: Centralizes all paths and identifiers so the workflow is portable.

parameters.command: cd /d {{ $json.PROJECT_ROOT }} && git status --porcelain && git log -1 --oneline && git branch --show-current

nodes.name: 1. Git Status (read-only)
nodes.notes: Capture current branch, HEAD, and working tree state. No commits made.

parameters.command: docker ps -a --filter name={{ $json.CONTAINER_NAME }} --format "table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}\t{{.Image}}" && echo --- && docker images --filter reference=noufex --format "table {{.Repository}}\t{{.Tag}}\t{{.Size}}"

nodes.name: 2. Docker + Nouf-ex Container
nodes.notes: Lists ONLY the Nouf-ex container. Other projects' containers (codepilot-db, postgres_agent, registry explorer) are NEVER inspected or modified.

parameters.command: set PGPASSWORD=<redacted-from-env>& "C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\17\bin\psql.exe" -h localhost -p 5432 -U noufex_app -d {{ $json.DB_NAME }} -t -c "SELECT current_user, current_database(), version();" -c "\dt public.*" -c "SELECT count(*) AS n_users FROM users; SELECT count(*) AS n_products FROM products;" -c "SELECT version, description FROM schema_migrations ORDER BY version;"

nodes.name: 3. noufex_db Audit (read-only)
nodes.notes: Connects ONLY to noufex_db via the noufex_app least-privilege role. All queries are read-only (SELECT, \dt). No other database on the host is touched.

nodes.name: 4. TypeScript Typecheck
nodes.notes: Runs `tsc -b --noEmit` over all 3 projects (app/server/node). Exit 0 = PASS.

nodes.name: 5. ESLint
nodes.notes: Full repo lint with zero-warning threshold.

parameters.command: cd /d {{ $json.APP_DIR }} && npm test -- --reporter=default 2>&1 | tee {{ $json.PROJECT_ROOT }}\scripts\_test_results.json | Select-String -Pattern "Test Files|Tests +\d+" | Select-Object -Last 5

nodes.name: 6. Vitest
nodes.notes: Captures pass/fail count for both |server| (Node) and |dom| (happy-dom) projects.

nodes.name: 7. Build (Vite + esbuild)
nodes.notes: Builds frontend SPA and bundles API server/index.js via esbuild. 3-stage Dockerfile build is a separate step (8b).

parameters.command: cd /d {{ $json.PROJECT_ROOT }} && docker build -t noufex:latest . 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath scripts\_build_docker.out | Select-Object -Last 5

nodes.name: 8. Docker Image Build
nodes.notes: 3-stage build (deps -> build -> runtime). May take 5-15 min on first run (npm ci of 877 packages).

nodes.name: 9. Start Nouf-ex Container
nodes.notes: If DB_HOST in .env is 'localhost' (Windows host scenario), use the override env file at scripts/n8n-env-override.env which sets DB_HOST=host.docker.internal. NEVER modifies the original .env.

parameters.command: $status = docker inspect --format='{{.State.Health.Status}}' {{ $json.CONTAINER_NAME }}; Write-Host "health=$status"; if ($status -ne 'healthy') { Write-Host 'Container not healthy yet — waiting up to 90s'; for ($i=1; $i -le 18; $i++) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; $status = docker inspect --format='{{.State.Health.Status}}' {{ $json.CONTAINER_NAME }}; if ($status -eq 'healthy') { break } }; docker logs {{ $json.CONTAINER_NAME }} --tail 30 }

nodes.name: 9b. Wait for Healthy
nodes.notes: Polls docker inspect State.Health.Status up to 90s. Shows last 30 log lines on failure.

nodes.name: 10b. GET /api/ready
nodes.notes: Readiness probe (verifies DB connectivity). Expect HTTP 200 + status='ready' + checks.db.ok=true.

parameters.command: echo "If and only if ALL of: typecheck=0, lint=0, tests pass, /api/health=200, /api/ready=200, AND human approves, then:"; echo "  cd /d {{ $json.PROJECT_ROOT }} && git add -A && git status --short && echo 'AWAITING HUMAN APPROVAL — DO NOT COMMIT AUTOMATICALLY'"

nodes.name: 11. Manual Approval Gate (NO auto-commit)
nodes.notes: WORKFLOW STOPS HERE. Human must run the displayed git command manually. NO push, NO commit, NO force operation is performed by the workflow itself.

parameters.prompt:
You are a senior DevOps reviewer. Synthesize the JSON outputs from the 10 preceding steps (git status, docker state, db audit, typecheck, lint, tests, build, container start, /api/health, /api/ready) into a single Markdown report.

REQUIRED SECTIONS:
1. Executive summary (one paragraph: overall PASS/FAIL + key blockers)
2. Per-step results table (step | status | duration | key metric)
3. Critical findings (anything blocking production)
4. Warnings (non-blocking issues)
5. Recommendations (prioritized)

CONSTRAINTS:
- If any step is FAIL, the overall verdict is FAIL.
- Never suggest auto-committing or pushing. Always end with: 'Awaiting human approval for git operations.'
- Cite exact file paths, line numbers, and HTTP status codes.
- Do not invent data; use only what the steps produced.

Output: pure Markdown only. No JSON wrapper.

nodes.name: AI Agent — Final Report
nodes.notes: The 'AI Agent' in this workflow. It only READS step outputs and synthesizes them. It does not execute any commands.

description: Read-only weekly review of the Nouf-ex stack: git state, Docker, noufex_db, typecheck, lint, tests, build, container start, /api/health, /api/ready. Halts before any git commit/push and requires human approval. Does not touch other projects' databases or containers.
